formal_statement: ¬ (∀ (q N : ℕ) (I : Fin N → Fin N → Prop) [DecidableRel I] (gates : List PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (out : Fin N → ℕ), N = q * q + q + 1 → (∀ l0 : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun p0 : Fin N => I p0 l0)).card = q + 1) → (∀ p1 p2 : Fin N, p1 ≠ p2 → ∃! l1 : Fin N, I p1 l1 ∧ I p2 l1) → (∀ g ∈ gates, (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨ g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.or) ∧ g.inputs.length ≤ 2) → (∀ ak : ℕ, ak < gates.length → (Finset.univ.filter (fun au : Fin N => (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun auk : Fin N => decide (auk = au)))).getD (N + ak) false = true)).card ≤ 1 → ∀ ax : Fin N → Bool, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn ax)).getD (N + ak) false = decide (∃ av : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun avk : Fin N => decide (avk = av)))).getD (N + ak) false = true ∧ ax av = true)) → (∀ (l2 : Fin N) (x : Fin N → Bool), (∀ cl : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun cp : Fin N => I cp cl ∧ x cp = true)).card ≤ 2) → (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn x)).getD (out l2) false = decide (∃ p3 : Fin N, I p3 l2 ∧ x p3 = true)) → ∀ (B : Finset (Fin N)) (H : Finset (Fin gates.length)), (∀ l3 ∈ B, ¬ (∃ ey : Fin N → Bool, (∀ eal : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun eap : Fin N => I eap eal ∧ ey eap = true)).card ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ ep0 : Fin N, I ep0 l3 → ey ep0 = false) ∧ ∀ ebw : ℕ, (∃ (ebk : ℕ) (ebg : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), (∀ ebK : Set ℕ, (∀ ebk0 : ℕ, ebk0 < gates.length → out l3 = N + ebk0 → (∀ ebu0 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun ebu0k : Fin N => decide (ebu0k = ebu0)))).getD (N + ebk0) false = true → ebu0 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun es : Fin N => I es l3))) → ebk0 ∈ ebK) → (∀ ebk1 ∈ ebK, ∀ (ebg1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (ebk2 : ℕ), gates[ebk1]? = some ebg1 → N + ebk2 ∈ ebg1.inputs → ebk2 < ebk1 → (∀ ebu1 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun ebu1k : Fin N => decide (ebu1k = ebu1)))).getD (N + ebk2) false = true → ebu1 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun es : Fin N => I es l3))) → ebk2 ∈ ebK) → ebk ∈ ebK) ∧ gates[ebk]? = some ebg ∧ ebg.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ ebw ∈ ebg.inputs ∧ ebw < N + ebk ∧ ¬ (∀ ebu2 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun ebu2k : Fin N => decide (ebu2k = ebu2)))).getD (ebw) false = true → ebu2 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun es : Fin N => I es l3)))) → ∃ eu4 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun eu4k : Fin N => decide (eu4k = eu4)))).getD (ebw) false = true ∧ ey eu4 = true)) → (∀ k5 ∈ H, 2 ≤ (Finset.univ.filter (fun u5 : Fin N => (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun u5k : Fin N => decide (u5k = u5)))).getD (N + k5.val) false = true)).card ∧ ∃ l4 : Fin N, (∃ fy : Fin N → Bool, (∀ fal : Fin N, (Finset.univ.filter (fun fap : Fin N => I fap fal ∧ fy fap = true)).card ≤ 2) ∧ (∀ fp0 : Fin N, I fp0 l4 → fy fp0 = false) ∧ ∀ fbw : ℕ, (∃ (fbk : ℕ) (fbg : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate), (∀ fbK : Set ℕ, (∀ fbk0 : ℕ, fbk0 < gates.length → out l4 = N + fbk0 → (∀ fbu0 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fbu0k : Fin N => decide (fbu0k = fbu0)))).getD (N + fbk0) false = true → fbu0 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun fs : Fin N => I fs l4))) → fbk0 ∈ fbK) → (∀ fbk1 ∈ fbK, ∀ (fbg1 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (fbk2 : ℕ), gates[fbk1]? = some fbg1 → N + fbk2 ∈ fbg1.inputs → fbk2 < fbk1 → (∀ fbu1 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fbu1k : Fin N => decide (fbu1k = fbu1)))).getD (N + fbk2) false = true → fbu1 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun fs : Fin N => I fs l4))) → fbk2 ∈ fbK) → fbk ∈ fbK) ∧ gates[fbk]? = some fbg ∧ fbg.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∧ fbw ∈ fbg.inputs ∧ fbw < N + fbk ∧ ¬ (∀ fbu2 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fbu2k : Fin N => decide (fbu2k = fbu2)))).getD (fbw) false = true → fbu2 ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun fs : Fin N => I fs l4)))) → ∃ fu4 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun fu4k : Fin N => decide (fu4k = fu4)))).getD (fbw) false = true ∧ fy fu4 = true) ∧ ∀ u6 : Fin N, (PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit.wires ⟨gates, 0⟩ (List.ofFn (fun u6k : Fin N => decide (u6k = u6)))).getD (N + k5.val) false = true → I u6 l4) → q * B.card + 2 * H.card ≤ 2 * gates.length)
plain_statement: Plane of order q: N = q^2 + q + 1 points and lines, q + 1 points per line, two points on one line; arc: at most two points per line. S_g: points where wire g is 1 when only that point is on. Is there a fan-in-two AND/OR list, each gate with |S_g| <= 1 equal to OR of S_g, outputs t_l equal to OR of l on arcs, where q times the leaking lines plus twice the gates with |S_g| >= 2 inside a good line exceeds twice the gates? (Leaking: no arc missing l meets S_a for every wire a read by an AND gate of the core of l with S_a not inside l.) Conjecture.
title: Search: a plane of order q and a normalized fan-in-two AND/OR list right on arcs whose leaking lines pay under q/2 gates each
